message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically covers about 380–400 miles (roughly 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major detours or heavy congestion—a straight drive would take around **6 to 7 hours**. In practice, traffic on the I‑5, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area, can add an hour or more, so many drivers plan for **7–8 hours** or even longer during peak commute times or holiday weekends.
